title: Peripheral Blood Sample Processing and RNA Extraction for qRT-PCR in NSCLC Patients
author: Bahareh Forouzani-Haghighi
materials: RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit
Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix
Extract total RNA using RNeasy Midi Kit (Qiagen, Cat# 74104) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Elute RNA in 100 μL RNase-free water.
Synthesize cDNA from 1 μg of total RNA using RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (Thermo Fisher, Cat# K1622) following the thermal profile: 65°C for 5 min, 42°C for 60 min, 70°C for 5 min.
Use beta-actin (ACTB) as the housekeeping gene.

steps.title: Collect Peripheral Blood
steps.instruction: Collect 5 mL of peripheral blood in sterile EDTA-K2 tubes during routine follow-up visits.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Processing
steps.instruction: Keep samples at 4°C and process within 2 hours to ensure RNA integrity.

steps.title: Perform Leukocyte Separation
steps.instruction: Separate leukocytes using Ficoll density gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Layer the diluted blood over Ficoll in 15 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 20 minutes at room temperature with the brake off.

steps.title: Collect and Store Buffy Coat
steps.instruction: Collect the buffy coat layer using a sterile pipette and transfer to RNase-free tubes.

substeps.instruction: Store immediately at −80°C until RNA extraction.

steps.title: Assess RNA Quantity and Purity
steps.instruction: Use a NanoDrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer to record A260, A260/A280, and A260/A230 ratios.

steps.title: Evaluate RNA Integrity
steps.instruction: Perform 1% agarose gel electrophoresis in 1× TAE buffer stained with SYBR Green II RNA stain.

substeps.instruction: Confirm the presence of 28S and 18S bands.

steps.title: Perform qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct qRT-PCR using the LightCycler 96 system (Roche) and Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix (Thermo Fisher, Cat# K0221).

substeps.instruction: Include technical duplicates for each sample.

steps.title: Calculate Relative Expression
steps.instruction: Calculate relative expression using the 2^−ΔCT method and report normalized GRα and GRβ expression levels.
